results.description: Community. We all have to work together to survive. (Good)
Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who forge them. (Chaotic)
Greed. I'm only in it for the money. (Evil)
Tradition. The old ways must be preserved. (Lawful)
Honesty. I never lie, even when the truth is unpleasant. (Good)
Power. Only the strong survive, and I intend to be one of them. (Evil)
Mercy. Even my enemies deserve a chance to surrender. (Good)
Charity. What I have, I share with those who have less. (Good)
Redemption. No one is beyond saving, including me. (Good)
Sacrifice. I would give my life to save a stranger's. (Good)
Kindness. A small act of compassion is never wasted. (Good)
Protection. The strong exist to shield the weak. (Good)
Forgiveness. Holding onto anger only poisons the one who holds it. (Good)
Hope. Even in the darkest places, something good can grow. (Good)
Healing. My purpose is to mend what's broken, not add to the ruin. (Good)
Selflessness. My own comfort matters less than others' survival. (Good)
Justice for the Powerless. Those who can't fight for themselves deserve someone who will. (Good)
Generosity. Wealth means nothing if it isn't shared. (Good)
Faith in Others. People rise to meet the trust placed in them. (Good)
Compassion. I judge people by their suffering, not their crimes. (Good)
Guidance. I owe it to those who taught me to teach others in turn. (Good)
Peace. Any war avoided is a victory worth having. (Good)
Domination. The world belongs to whoever is strong enough to take it. (Evil)
Cruelty. Fear is a far more reliable tool than kindness. (Evil)
Ambition. I will let nothing, and no one, stand between me and power. (Evil)
Vengeance. Every wrong done to me will be repaid tenfold. (Evil)
Survival of the Fittest. The weak exist to serve the strong. (Evil)
Deception. A well-placed lie is worth more than a hundred truths. (Evil)
Conquest. Territory is only ever borrowed until someone stronger arrives. (Evil)
Ruthlessness. Mercy is a debt I've never been able to afford. (Evil)
Corruption. Every soul has a price, and I intend to learn everyone's. (Evil)
Dominance. I was born to rule, and the rest were born to obey. (Evil)
Malice. Suffering is fascinating, and I intend to study it closely. (Evil)
Greed Above All. There is no such thing as enough. (Evil)
Tyranny. Order only exists because someone is willing to enforce it absolutely. (Evil)
Sacrifice of Others. Someone has to pay the price for progress, and it won't be me. (Evil)
Fear. A populace that fears me will never dare rise against me. (Evil)
Betrayal. Loyalty is a tool, and tools are meant to be used and discarded. (Evil)
Bloodlust. The battlefield is the only place I've ever truly felt alive. (Evil)
Darkness. The old gods of shadow deserve worship more than the false light ever did. (Evil)
Order. Chaos is the enemy of everything worth building. (Lawful)
Duty. My oath binds me more tightly than any chain could. (Lawful)
Discipline. Strength without control is just a disaster waiting to happen. (Lawful)
The Law. Rules exist to protect us from ourselves. (Lawful)
Hierarchy. Every structure needs someone at the top, and someone to answer to them. (Lawful)
Loyalty to the Crown. My duty to the throne outweighs my own wishes. (Lawful)
Contracts. A deal signed is a deal honored, whatever it costs me. (Lawful)
Structure. A society without rules is no society at all. (Lawful)
Honor. My word is worth more than my life. (Lawful)
The Chain of Command. Questioning orders is how good plans fall apart. (Lawful)
Precedent. What has worked before will work again. (Lawful)
Ritual. The old rites must be observed, exactly as they always have been. (Lawful)
Accountability. Everyone answers for their actions eventually, myself included. (Lawful)
Service. My guild comes before my own ambitions. (Lawful)
The Codex. Every question has already been answered, if you know where to look. (Lawful)
Rebellion. Every throne deserves to be tested. (Chaotic)
Impulse. Plans are just an excuse to hesitate. (Chaotic)
Change. Nothing should be allowed to stay the same for too long. (Chaotic)
Independence. I answer to no one but myself. (Chaotic)
Wanderlust. The road matters more to me than any destination. (Chaotic)
Anarchy. Every rule is a cage waiting to be broken. (Chaotic)
Whimsy. Life's too short to take seriously. (Chaotic)
Defiance. I'll do the opposite of whatever I'm told, on principle. (Chaotic)
Instinct. I trust my gut over anyone's careful plan. (Chaotic)
Unpredictability. If they can predict me, I've already lost. (Chaotic)
Individuality. Conformity is a slow kind of death. (Chaotic)
Luck. Fortune favors those bold enough to ignore the odds. (Chaotic)
Freedom of Thought. No idea is too dangerous to consider. (Chaotic)
Restlessness. Staying in one place too long feels like drowning. (Chaotic)
Disruption. The status quo was never going to save anyone. (Chaotic)
Balance. Too much of anything, even good, causes harm. (Neutral)
Nature. The wilds owe nothing to civilization, and I owe everything to the wilds. (Neutral)
Knowledge. Understanding the world matters more than judging it. (Neutral)
Self-Reliance. I trust my own strength before I trust anyone else's promises. (Neutral)
Pragmatism. Whatever gets the job done is the right approach. (Neutral)
Neutrality. I take no side in wars that aren't mine to fight. (Neutral)
Curiosity. Every mystery deserves to be understood, whatever the cost. (Neutral)
Coin. Everything has a price, mine included. (Neutral)
Craft. My work speaks louder than my intentions ever could. (Neutral)
Family. Blood matters more to me than any cause. (Neutral)
Legacy. I want to be remembered, more than I want to be good. (Neutral)
Survival. Whatever keeps me breathing another day is worth doing. (Neutral)
Patience. Everything comes to those willing to wait long enough. (Neutral)
Solitude. I trust silence more than most people's company. (Neutral)
Fate. Whatever happens was always going to happen. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I want to be remembered for something greater than myself. (Any)
Curiosity About the Self. I'm still trying to figure out who I really am. (Any)
The Craft. Whatever I do, I do it better than anyone else. (Any)
Belonging. I just want somewhere, and someone, to call my own. (Any)
Legacy of a Teacher. I owe it to my mentor to live up to what they saw in me. (Any)
The Journey. It's not about where I end up, it's about who I become along the way. (Any)
Proving Myself. I have something to prove, to them and to myself. (Any)
The Unfinished Task. I won't rest until what I started is finished. (Any)
Second Chances. Everyone deserves one more chance than they think they do. (Any)
Truth. Whatever else changes, I won't lie to myself about who I am. (Any)
The Debt. I owe someone everything, and I intend to pay it in full. (Any)
Reputation. What people say about me matters more than it should. (Any)
The Old Ways. However the world changes, some things are worth preserving. (Any)
Simplicity. The fewer things I need, the freer I am. (Any)
The Unanswered Question. There's something I need to know, whatever it takes. (Any)
